notes: Synthetic contract for buildathon demo. Structure mirrors typical Razorpay-style merchant fee agreements. All rates are illustrative.

card_terminal_settlement.description: Daily POS/card terminal batch settlement. MDR charged on gross card sales, GST on MDR.
card_terminal_settlement.special_clause: Promotional MDR of 1.50% applies to card terminal settlements between 2026-07-15 and 2026-07-31 as part of Q3 onboarding offer.

razorpay_payout_batch.description: Batch payout of online/UPI-via-Razorpay collections, net of platform commission.
razorpay_payout_batch.special_clause: Transactions settled via UPI collect flagged as 'UPI-' in narration are commission-free per NPCI zero-MDR-on-UPI mandate; only card/wallet-routed online payments attract the 2% commission.

mdr_recovery_charge.description: Periodic RuPay/debit card MDR recovery per RBI interchange notification, charged flat per recovery cycle.

neft_vendor_debits.description: Outgoing vendor/supplier payments initiated by merchant via NEFT. Not fee-bearing on merchant's inward settlement; excluded from fee reconciliation, included in balance reconciliation only.

gst_computation_base: GST is computed on the fee/commission amount, not on the gross transaction amount.
rounding_rule: All fee computations rounded to 2 decimal places using standard round-half-up.
